buyer_question: Does the AI workflow touch PHI, ePHI or patient data?
source_evidence_to_prepare: Redacted data-flow sketch, field inventory, workflow role labels, retention note
review_gate: Privacy or qualified adviser confirms allowed answer wording
unsafe_claim_to_block: HIPAA compliant AI without scoped evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not HIPAA advice or compliance proof

buyer_question: Can you sign a BAA and list AI/cloud subprocessors?
source_evidence_to_prepare: BAA status label, public subprocessor links, vendor/model register, contract-status note
review_gate: Legal owner approves what can be shared externally
boundary_label: Template row only; not legal advice or contract approval

buyer_question: What security certifications or control evidence can buyers review?
source_evidence_to_prepare: Current report/certificate status if available, evidence-room index, expiry/review dates
review_gate: Security owner marks approved, NDA-only or not available
unsafe_claim_to_block: SOC 2 or HITRUST proof without current evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not certification evidence

buyer_question: Is customer or patient data used for model training?
source_evidence_to_prepare: Provider terms link, prompt logging note, training-use status, exception register
review_gate: Approved answer source is attached for each workflow
unsafe_claim_to_block: We never train on customer data without source evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not privacy security or AI accuracy proof

buyer_question: Can spend be mapped to product, tenant, workflow or customer segment?
source_evidence_to_prepare: Redacted billing export, tag coverage, owner field, anomaly notes, workflow mapping
unsafe_claim_to_block: Cost savings or ROI without measured evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not savings ROI or revenue proof

buyer_question: Which AI outputs require human review or escalation?
source_evidence_to_prepare: Escalation categories, adviser-needed labels, override log, blocked automation examples
review_gate: Accountable adviser confirms non-AI decision boundary
unsafe_claim_to_block: AI handles clinical or billing decisions autonomously
boundary_label: Template row only; not medical clinical billing or legal advice

buyer_question: Which questionnaire answers are blocked or stale?
source_evidence_to_prepare: Questionnaire gap list, evidence age, owner, next action, blocker reason
review_gate: Owner signs off before buyer send
unsafe_claim_to_block: Questionnaire approved when owner review is missing
boundary_label: Template row only; not procurement approval evidence

buyer_question: What can marketing or sales claim about AI, compliance, savings or outcomes?
source_evidence_to_prepare: Claim log, source evidence, reviewer, approved wording, expiry date
review_gate: Claims are blocked unless source evidence and owner approval exist
unsafe_claim_to_block: Guaranteed compliance, rankings, savings or buyer approval
boundary_label: Template row only; not customer testimonial ranking outcome or revenue proof
